# Get access token from login result
access_token = login_result["access_token"]

# Fetch all friends using pagination
all_friends = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    friends_page = apis.venmo.search_friends(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not friends_page:
        break
    all_friends.extend(friends_page)
    if len(friends_page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

# Count friends added since start of January 2023
start_date = datetime(2023, 1, 1)
count = 0
for friend in all_friends:
    friends_since = datetime.fromisoformat(friend["friends_since"])
    if friends_since >= start_date:
        count += 1

print(count)
